title: Central Government discretion on value
description: The Central Government has discretion to prescribe a different value for consideration

content.general_rule: The National Commission has jurisdiction over complaints where the value of goods or services exceeds rupees ten crore
content.exception: The Central Government may prescribe a different value as it deems fit
conditions: The Central Government deems it necessary
